name: mapping
description: Drive the mapping RPC flow: start_mapping negotiates the code-book, then stop_mapping returns result_ready. (This exercises the mapping ORCHESTRATION over the app-driver; the deeper capture-screen path — synthetic camera feeding detections through the real decoder + solve — is a follow-up.) Requires a connected device.

steps.description: begin mapping; the device answers mapping_started with the code-book + epoch
finish; the device (or phone-solve) returns result_ready with a map id
